claims.disproof_condition: Downgrade if photonics/CPO disappears from served-market language in future filings, or if concentration re-spikes above 90% (single-customer dependency risk returns); upgrade only with customer naming or segment revenue split.
claims.statement: Aehr's audited FY2026 10-K names Co-Package Optics (CPO) and silicon photonics for data center infrastructure among its served markets — upgrading the [380] site-headline evidence to statutory-filing grade. Customer concentration is high but diversifying: top-five customers 93% (FY24) → 77% (FY25) → 70% (FY26), with FY2026's three largest at ~26%/14%/11% and none else above 10%. Customers remain unnamed (10-K practice); which of them is the silicon photonics buyer is not disclosed.

source_doc.permission_basis: Public SEC EDGAR filing; URL and short excerpts.
source_doc.title: Aehr Test Systems FY2026 10-K — silicon photonics/CPO market and customer concentration

sources.quote: silicon photonics for data center infrastructure, Co-Package Optics (CPO) and worldwide 5G infrastructure

Silicon photonics integrated circuits are also expanding into optical chip-to-chip communication, with multiple companies announcing roadmaps for co-packaged photonics integrated with microprocessors, graphics processors, and chipsets for computing and artificial intelligence applications.

Sales to our five largest customers accounted for approximately 70%, 77%, and 93% of our net sales in fiscal 2026, 2025, and 2024, respectively. During fiscal 2026, three customers accounted for approximately 26%, 14% and 11% of our net sales.
